description: This file manages session data for PHP applications using the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes functions for session serialization, regeneration, creation, and garbage collection, as well as a class for handling database connections and session operations.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A class encapsulating database connection and session management functions, including session open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection. It uses static methods and properties to manage configuration and connection state.

methods.name: adodb_unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes session data stored as a serialized string into PHP variables.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID and updates the database record accordingly.

methods.name: adodb_session_create_table
methods.description: Creates the database table used for storing session data based on provided schema file.
